items.question: Which practitioner is qualified to recite mantras while mounted upon a corpse there?
premises: The ritual setting is the previously specified cremation ground.
The practitioner mounts a corpse in that very place.
The reciter must be supremely knowledgeable in mantras.
items.inference: Only a supreme knower of mantras should perform recitation while mounted on a corpse there.
uncertainties: The specific mantra to be recited is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having mounted a corpse right there, whoever is the foremost knower of mantras should perform the recitation.
